note: Crafts of the Somatic Reaches/Cogitarium (body_mind axis). Soma is the body-pole tradition (the physical masteries, the body as instrument); Noesis the mind-pole (mental disciplines, memory-palaces, thought as force). Learned by traveling the Reach or training with Somatics/Cogitants. Both drift the wielder toward their pole; the perfected athlete-scholar is where they co-fire, the disembodied Cogitant where mind wins absolutely. axes signed for engine compat. Authored by Aevi (PO), SNG-016 — the last of the six near-axis traditions.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.narrationHints: Past the wall, and the body finds more.
abilities.description: Push the body past exhaustion, pain or shock — closing some of what is open, hitting harder for it, and at its height refusing to stop at all.

tree.name: Embrace the Suck
tree.grants: ⛔ IGNORE PAIN, FATIGUE, COLD OR SHOCK FOR A DECISIVE BURST — and the quality of what you are doing does not fall while it holds. ⚠️ IT ALSO CLOSES SOME OF WHAT IS ALREADY OPEN: a small heal, and a soak against the next blows on top of the resist.
tree.cannot: ⛔ Damage ignored is applied when it ends.
tree._cannotWas: The body remembers the debt. What you ignore is still there when it ends.

tree.name: Third Wind
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS EMPOWERED ATTACKS AND NO DAILY LIMIT. What you find is not simply more of what you had — you are stronger and faster than your own rested self, and your blows land harder for it. ⚠️ AND THE DURATION NOW APPLIES INSIDE A FIGHT, not just across a march.
tree.cannot: ⛔ Damage ignored is applied when it ends; the empowered state ends with it.
tree._cannotWas: You are borrowing from tomorrow, and tomorrow collects with interest.

tree.name: Dream Breath
tree.grants: ⛔ GRANTS SOAK WORTH A SHARE OF YOUR MAXIMUM HEALTH, AND HEALS HALF THAT AMOUNT OUTRIGHT. The body does not stop until the work is done, and it tends itself as it runs — bleeding slows, shock recedes.
tree.cannot: ⛔ All damage ignored while it runs is applied when it ends.
tree._cannotWas: ⚠️ HELD OFF IS NOT HEALED. Everything deferred arrives at once when you stop, and it arrives worse.

rankDeltas.delta: find breath and strength past where the body had none — TWICE IN ONE DAY, at a cost
SPECIAL: go on past exhaustion FOR AS LONG AS THE THING NEEDS DOING — the body simply does not stop, and it TENDS ITSELF as it runs

intensity.conserve: a small push — half the burst, and the debt is light
intensity.surge: double it; THE BODY IS BORROWING FROM TOMORROW, AND TOMORROW COLLECTS WITH INTEREST

bounds.text: THE BODY REMEMBERS THE DEBT — overuse breaks you
the body is BORROWING FROM TOMORROW
HELD OFF IS NOT HEALED — everything deferred ARRIVES AT ONCE when you stop

abilities.plainly: A survive/chase/fight action that strengthens someone. Its strength is rated 4 out of 10, and lasts for about an hour Ranks: rank 2 extends uses; rank 3 adds to special. Limit: held Off IS Not Healed — everything deferred Arrives AT Once when you stop.

sectFlavour.somatic: TRAINED BREATH AND HEARTBEAT — you know exactly what you are spending.
sectFlavour.mason: THE NEXT CORRECT ACTION TAKEN, not inspiration. Absorbs Long Haul.

abilities.name: Perfect Motion
abilities.narrationHints: The body does exactly and only what's needed, flawlessly.
abilities.description: Execute a physical act with impossible precision and economy — dodge what you saw coming, waste no motion, and at its height act before you have decided to.
abilities.notFor: Feats past the body's true ceiling; thought-work.

tree.name: Acrobatics
tree.grants: ⛔ ONE PHYSICAL ACT AT THE EDGE OF THE POSSIBLE, EXECUTED EXACTLY — a landing, a catch, a cut, a climb. ⚠️ AND IT EVADES: use it to take yourself out of the path of a blow you saw coming.
tree.cannot: One act. The true limit still holds, and it costs the body.

tree.name: Unwasted Motion
tree.grants: ⚠️ ADDS ECONOMY AS A CONDITION. Every motion does only what it must — blocks cost you nothing, you are never out of position, and you do not tire from moving well.
tree.cannot: Efficiency is not power. A perfect motion still loses to a stronger one.

tree.name: Motion Without Thought
tree.grants: ⛔ THE BODY ACTS BEFORE THE DECISION — A SECOND PHYSICAL ACTION THIS ROUND. ⚠️ And a strike thrown with the whole mastered frame behind it, stance and breath and timing arriving together, wounds far past what the same arm could do untrained.
tree.cannot: ⛔ Once per round. The body chooses — if you have trained it badly, it will do that beautifully.

mechanic.note: AN EIGHTH DEFENSIVE LOGIC — EFFICIENT: not armour, not absence, not misdirection, but never making a wasted or wrong motion. Uses Erik's evasion model; zero soak because a perfect motion still takes the blow it cannot avoid.

rankDeltas.delta: NO MOTION YOU MAKE IS WASTED — every step, block and reach does exactly and only what it must
SPECIAL: THE BODY ACTS CORRECTLY BEFORE THE MIND KNOWS THERE WAS A DECISION — and it is right

intensity.conserve: move cleanly — half the efficiency, and it costs the body nothing
intensity.surge: double it; EFFICIENCY IS NOT POWER — a perfect motion still loses to a strong enough one

bounds.text: THE TRUE LIMIT STILL HOLDS; it costs the body dearly
EFFICIENCY IS NOT POWER — a perfect motion still loses to a strong enough one
THE BODY CHOOSES — if you have trained it badly, IT WILL DO THAT PERFECTLY

abilities.name: Memory-Palace
abilities.narrationHints: They go still and their eyes track across nothing, left to right, like someone reading. Then they tell you where they have seen that man before.
abilities.description: Search your own memory for something that bears on what you are doing — and let it sharpen the attempt.
abilities.notFor: Wisdom; presence in the body it forgets.

tree.name: Cross-Reference
tree.grants: ⛔ SEARCH YOUR OWN ATTENDED MEMORY FOR SOMETHING THAT BEARS ON WHAT YOU ARE DOING — a similar lock, a face, a passage read once, a fight fought before. ⚠️ MECHANICALLY: roll to determine how much it helps; on a success your next attempt gains a bonus to succeed AND a widened crit range.
tree.cannot: One attempt, and you must have attended to something relevant. A subject you have never encountered gives you nothing.

tree.name: The Whole House
tree.grants: ⚠️ ADDS RELIABILITY AND CEILING. The search no longer fails to find something usable, and the bonus lands at its maximum rather than being rolled for.
tree.cannot: Still your own memory. It takes a quiet moment you may not have in a fight.

tree.name: The Borrowed Room
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS SOMEONE ELSE'S. Enter a willing — or unresisting — mind and search THEIR memory: their route, their language, their trade. ⚠️ FOR ONE ATTEMPT YOU MAY USE A SKILL THEY HAVE AND YOU DO NOT, at their rank.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ A resisting mind can refuse and a hostile one costs you. You get what THEY attended to, including what they were wrong about.

mechanic.note: T-III. duration effectively permanent — 'nothing you have attended to is lost'

rankDeltas.delta: store not just FACTS but EXPERIENCES WHOLE — walk back into a conversation and hear it again exactly
SPECIAL: NOTHING YOU HAVE ATTENDED TO IS LOST — the whole of your life is a place you can walk through

intensity.conserve: store what matters — half the depth, and you can let the rest go
intensity.surge: double it; WHAT YOU STORE, YOU KEEP — INCLUDING WHAT YOU WOULD RATHER HAVE LOST

bounds.text: ONLY AS GOOD AS ITS INPUTS — living in the model loses the room
WHAT YOU STORE, YOU KEEP — INCLUDING WHAT YOU WOULD RATHER HAVE LOST

abilities.plainly: A investigate/puzzle action that reveals information or sets up a later action. Its strength is rated 6 out of 10, and lasts for about 12 months Ranks: rank 2 deepens recallDepth; rank 3 adds to special. Limit: only AS Good AS Its Inputs — living in the model loses the room.

_treeWas.name: Near Rooms
_treeWas.grants: ⛔ SEARCH WHAT YOU HAVE ATTENDED TO IN RECENT WEEKS AND FIND THE MATCH — the face at this gate was at that funeral, the same hand signed both ledgers, this phrase was in a letter you read.
_treeWas.cannot: Only what you ATTENDED to, and only weeks back. Background you did not look at was never stored.

_treeWas.name: Whole House
_treeWas.grants: ⚠️ ADDS DEPTH OF TIME. The search runs across your entire life — childhood, the war, a road you walked once twenty years ago — and returns it whole: tone, order, who said what, and what was not said.
_treeWas.cannot: Still only your own attending. A long search takes a quiet minute you may not have.

_treeWas.name: Borrowed Room
_treeWas.grants: ⛔ ADDS SOMEONE ELSE. Enter a willing — or unresisting — mind and search THEIR memory the same way. The dying man's last road, the witness who saw it and cannot say it, the prisoner who does not know what they know.
_treeWas.cannot: ⚠️ A RESISTING MIND CAN REFUSE, and a hostile one costs you. You get what THEY attended to, including what they were wrong about.

abilities.name: Skydancer
abilities.narrationHints: The body treats the air like ground — a leap becomes a bound becomes something the earth stopped being able to stop.
abilities.description: Take steps on open air — cross what has no bottom, climb what has no holds, and come down from any height under control.
abilities.notFor: Sustained hovering or true flight (it's bursts, momentum-bound); carrying heavy loads aloft.

tree.name: Air-Step
tree.grants: ⛔ TAKE A STEP ON NOTHING. One footfall in open air per bound — cross a gap with no bottom, run a vertical wall for its full height, drop three storeys and keep moving. ⚠️ WHERE LOOSE-LIMBED LEAVES THE GROUND AND RETURNS TO IT, THIS DOES NOT NEED GROUND AT ALL.
tree.cannot: Each step must be taken while still moving. Stop, and you fall from wherever you are.

tree.name: Long Air
tree.grants: ⚠️ ADDS DURATION AND HEIGHT. Chain the steps without touching down — cross a canyon, ascend a tower face unbroken, hold a position in open air long enough to fight from it.
tree.cannot: You must keep moving. Fighting from the air costs a step per exchange.

tree.name: Carry the Line
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS OTHERS AND DESCENT. Take a rope, a line or a person up with you — and come down under control from any height at all.
tree.cannot: One passenger or one line. A falling body you catch is a passenger.
tree._gainNote: ⚠️ A passenger is targets; controlled descent from any height is quality.

rankDeltas.delta: CHAIN the air-steps WITHOUT TOUCHING DOWN — cross a canyon, ascend a tower face in one unbroken sequence

intensity.conserve: a few bounds — half the distance, and a missed step is survivable
intensity.surge: double the chain; A MISTIMED STEP AT HEIGHT IS A FALL

bounds.text: MOMENTUM-BOUND — you must keep moving; THERE IS NO HOVER AT ANY MASTERY
a mistimed step is a real fall

SKYDANCER DOES NOT NEED GROUND AT ALL. r3 adds a passenger and controlled descent from any height.

abilities.name: Working Model
abilities.narrationHints: They stand still for a long moment doing nothing visible, and then work without pausing once, and there are no offcuts.
abilities.description: Model a thing so completely in your head that the making is only following the thought — and build it faster and truer than your tools should allow.

tree.name: Single Thing
tree.grants: ⛔ ONE ITEM, OR A SPACE YOU CAN STAND IN AND SEE. A lock, a brace, a splint, a door, a cart-repair, a small room re-laid. You need no plan and you waste no material.
tree.cannot: One object or one small space at a time. You must be able to examine it.

tree.name: Whole Working
tree.grants: ⚠️ ADDS SYSTEMS AND COMPOUNDS. A machine with parts that move against each other, a building, a body, a workshop yard — anything whose pieces have to agree. Diagnose its faults and redesign it from the inside.
tree.cannot: You must have access to the whole of it; a system half-hidden is modelled half-wrong.

tree.name: Modelled Country
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS COMPLEXITY AND DELEGATION. Hold a working with many interacting parts — a mill and its race, a fortification and its approaches — and hand the model to others: anyone you brief can build their piece correctly without understanding the whole.
tree.cannot: One such working at a time, and you must be able to get around the whole of it.
tree._grantsWas: ⛔ ADDS COMPLEXITY AND DISTRICT SCALE. A mill and its race, a fortification and its approaches, a quarter's drainage. Held entire, and rebuilt entire.
tree._rebalance: ⚠️ Was the third scope-gain in a row for this skill. Delegation is what a modeller actually does at that scale.

THE NEW ARC IS SCOPE, and scope is legible at the table. `reveal` stripped: the modelling is HOW it makes, not a separate perception. ⚠️ ERIK: 'NO to the cost' on r3. Removed.

abilities.name: Shaped Body
abilities.narrationHints: Train the body past what the body thinks it can be. A new configuration, held.
abilities.description: Condition the body until it stops taking harm the way bodies do — soaking blows, shrugging off cold and venom, and finally giving crafts poor purchase.

tree.name: Hardened
tree.grants: ⛔ SOAK DAMAGE OUTRIGHT. Sustained conditioning gives you a standing reduction on every physical blow you take — not a dodge, not armour, the body itself.
tree.cannot: Physical harm only. It does not stack with worn armour of the same weight.

tree.name: Seasoned
tree.grants: ⚠️ ADDS RESISTANCE TO NATURAL SUBSTANCES. Bigger soak, and cold, heat, smoke, venom, rot and bad water take far less hold on you than they should.
tree.cannot: Natural substances only — a crafted working is untouched at this rank.

tree.name: Body Is Clay
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS IMMUNITY AND CRAFT-RESISTANCE. Natural substances stop affecting you at all, and crafts worked directly on your body find it harder ground than it should be.
tree.cannot: Immune to natural substances; merely RESISTANT to crafts. A craft worked on the world around you is unaffected.
tree._gainNote: ⛔ Immunity to natural substances and resistance to crafts are CONDITIONS you now operate under.

what you shape you HAVE SHAPED — it does not simply revert

abilities.name: Unmoving Mind
abilities.narrationHints: Everything they throw at your thoughts slides off a stillness that was there before they arrived and will be there after they tire. You did not brace. You were simply already still.
abilities.description: Enter a stillness nothing can move — fear, pain, deception and the fastest attack all slide off it, and you keep reading the room while they try.
abilities.notFor: It is defense and clarity, never force — you cannot strike with stillness, only see and endure. And a mind held perfectly still holds nothing else; while you are unmoving you are only unmoving.

tree.name: Still Mind
tree.grants: Enter a stillness fear, pain and distraction do not reach. You think and work clean while the room comes apart.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ It occupies you — entering it means standing still and doing one thing.

tree.name: Stillness While Moving
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS ACTING. Hold it while fighting, walking, negotiating or climbing — the clarity comes with you instead of costing you the scene.
tree.cannot: You are calm, not faster. It does not help you win, only stop losing to yourself.

tree.name: Nothing Lands
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS DECEPTION AND DISRUPTION AS CONDITIONS YOU ACT THROUGH. A lie, a feint, a shock or a working meant to unseat you slides off — and you read the attempt AS IT FAILS, which tells you what they wanted.
tree.cannot: A true thing you cannot bear is still true. This turns aside what is AIMED at you, not what is so.
tree._grantsWas: ⚠️ ADDS DECEPTION AND DISRUPTION. Not only fear and pain now — a lie, a feint, a shock or a working meant to unseat you slides off, and you read it as it fails.
tree._rebalance: ⛔ I authored this rank in batch 2 and it failed my own test — 'deception slides off too' named no gain. Now it is conditions + quality, and the reading-the-attempt clause makes it an act rather than a state.

abilities._descriptionWas: The Cogitant art of mushin — no-mind, the perfect stillness that nothing can move: not fear, not deception, not the fastest attack, because a mind that does not flinch reads everything and grants nothing. The blade-discipline made total.
abilities._strip: ⛔ SNG-453: incidental `reveal`/`foresee` stripped — the perceiving is the setup step, not the effect.

_treeWas.name: The Unmoving Mind
_treeWas.grants: Enter a perfect mental stillness — immune to fear, deception, and disruption, reading all with total clarity.
_treeWas.cannot: It grants no offense, only the unshakeable read; it occupies you wholly to hold; and a stillness this deep can look, to those who love you, like you have gone somewhere they cannot follow.

_treeWas.name: The Moving Stillness
_treeWas.grants: The stillness no longer occupies you wholly — hold it while fighting, walking, negotiating, and the clarity holds with it. And it reaches past you: those who stand with you and trust you are steadied by proximity, and do not break when they should.
_treeWas.cannot: Extending it thins it — the more you shelter, the less clearly you read. It still grants no offense at any depth. And those sheltered feel the flinch you are not having, which more than one person has found worse than their own fear.

abilities._merged: ⛔ SNG-457: MERGES Total Focus (L1, e4) — whose three ranks were one sentence with intensifiers: 'fear, pain and distraction fall away' → 'stop reaching you' → 'nothing else exists'. ⚠️ THE UNMOVING MIND'S r2 WAS THE ONLY REAL ADVANCE IN EITHER — 'hold it while fighting, walking, negotiating' — and it had only two ranks. One skill now, and each rank adds a thing: stillness → stillness while acting → deception slides off too.

abilities.name: Convergent Strike
abilities.narrationHints: No wind-up and no flourish. They move once, and the thing that was a fight is over, and afterwards nobody can agree on what they saw.
abilities.description: Read every thread of threat in a contest at once — the unarmoured seam, the failing grip, the worst possible instant, the sharpest part of the blade or the finest edge of a psychic figure — and bring them all onto one point.
abilities.notFor: One stroke, read and delivered perfectly, at enormous cost of focus — and it demands the opening be real; against something with no decisive instant (a flood, a crowd, a lie with no center) there is no single stroke to find.

tree.name: Convergent Strike
tree.grants: ⛔ EVERY THREAD OF THREAT CONVERGES ON ONE POINT — weak spot, unarmoured seam, maximum leverage, the sharpest part of the blade or the finest edge of a figure, all at the same instant. ⚠️ THE LARGEST SINGLE HIT IN THE TRADITION.
tree.cannot: It costs nearly all your focus, it requires a real decisive instant to exist, and it is the blade's truth and the pen's alike — some contests have no single stroke, and mistaking that is how the sure-handed fall.

abilities.name: Answered Motion
abilities.narrationHints: You read the body's next movement in the movement before it, and put your hand exactly where that movement is going. Joints go the wrong way. Weight arrives where they were not standing. Nothing wasted, nothing telegraphed, all of it at contact range.
abilities.description: Meet a committed movement and finish it wrong — an elbow past its travel, a knee folded inward, a wrist that will not close on a weapon again today. Real breakage at contact range, and the Somatics' first offense: not force but ANSWER.
abilities.notFor: Reach (this is a hand's length; a spear is a real answer to it); the motionless (a set, braced, patient opponent gives you almost nothing); crowds — it is one body at a time; anything whose body you cannot read.

tree.name: Turned Joint
tree.grants: Meet a committed movement and finish it wrong — an elbow past its travel, a knee folded inward, a wrist that will not close on a weapon again today.
tree.cannot: They must be committed to a movement. A cautious opponent gives you nothing.

tree.name: Given Fall
tree.grants: ⚠️ ADDS THEIR WEIGHT AS WELL AS THEIR LIMB — put a body into the ground, a wall, a stairwell, or another body.
tree.cannot: One body per action, and you must have the footing to take the weight.

tree.name: Taken Apart
tree.grants: ⛔ GO TO THE SEAMS. A body is a structure and you know where this one comes apart — joints and rhythm first, so they stop being able to fight long before they stop. Every motion answered as it arrives, for as long as they keep making them.
tree.cannot: Contact range. Something with no joints is not taken apart this way.

intensity.conserve: turn the joint and let go
intensity.surge: answer everything; IT ONLY WORKS ON THE MOVING — a man who stops is beyond you

bounds.text: CONTACT RANGE ONLY
they must be MOVING — the braced and patient give nothing
one body at a time
reach beats it — a spear keeps you out

abilities.plainly: A fight action that turns an opponent's own movement into their injury. Rated 7 of 10 on one target. Limit: contact range, and they must be moving.
abilities.backlash: You read the motion wrong and finish INTO it. Their weight arrives where you are, and you take the strike you were answering.
abilities.conserveSuppresses: turn the joint and let go — a misread costs position, not bone
abilities._backlashRungNote: SNG-359 CORRECTION 2026-08-08: my first split was intrinsic-vs-placed — does the CRAFT route through the wielder. That is the wrong question. The only question a backlash rung answers is: DOES THIS FAILURE HARM THE WIELDER? A placed craft that comes down on the person who placed it harms them just as surely as a conduit craft that reverses. 9 of the 12 I had left unset do harm the wielder and now carry a rung.

abilities.name: Sustained Regard
abilities.narrationHints: You give them the whole of your attention and refuse to give it back. Under a regard that complete the body starts dropping the things it was doing unattended — balance, breath, the grip on a weapon, the clotting of a wound.
abilities.description: Fix the whole of your attention on one person in sight and refuse to give it back. Balance, breath, grip and the clotting of a wound all falter. No vector, no contact — the Cogitants' first offense.
abilities.notFor: Anything you cannot see or have not met; several at once (it is ALL of your attention, that is the whole mechanism); acting well yourself while you hold it; the disciplined, who can hold their own attention against yours.

tree.name: Whole of It
tree.grants: Fix the entirety of your attention on one person in sight. Autonomic things falter — vision greys, a limb goes uncertain, breath stumbles, an open wound stops closing. They know they are being looked at and cannot say why it hurts.
tree.cannot: ONE TARGET, and it costs you nearly all of your own action while it holds. A trained mind resists and knows what you are doing. Break line of sight and it ends.

tree.name: Held Regard
tree.grants: Keep it. What their body was running unattended stays unrun — they cannot rally, cannot steady, cannot stop bleeding, for as long as you look.
tree.cannot: You are doing nothing else. ⚠ A SECOND ENEMY WHILE YOU HOLD THIS IS HOW COGITANTS DIE. No one else takes a harm rung from it, and no one else can lift it for you; only the wielder can drop it.

tree.name: Undivided
tree.grants: Attention at a weight a body cannot be looked at under. Things stop. Hearts are things. AND YOU KEEP YOURSELF NOW: the wielder no longer stops running their own body to do it, and can act while the regard holds.
tree.cannot: Still ONE TARGET, still line of sight, and a trained mind still knows what you are doing and who is doing it. The Discarnate reach this rank and then keep going, which is how they stop coming back.

intensity.surge: give it more than the whole of your attention — reach past line of sight, and THE WIELDER IS STRUCK AT 'damaging' for it
